verdicts.quote: when a seat opens, the head of the waitlist is booked at once. There is no offer, confirm or hold window.
by server-recorded join order. No priority tiers. … M5 and M6 join concurrently → positions 1 and 2 in some order, never both 1. … Staff get no waitlist view and no manual promotion in this change.
A member holding a time-overlapping booking elsewhere is handled by the existing eligibility rules (P-1).
verdicts.missing: Whether promotion into one class immediately removes the member from an overlapping class’s waitlist or leaves that entry for a later eligibility check.

verdicts.quote: There is no offer, confirm or hold window. … a late-cancel or no-show penalty exists … charge and penalise exactly as for a direct booking.
M1 cancels → booked [M2, M3], list [M4, M5] … promotion happens inside the cancellation operation. When the cancel request has returned, a read-back already shows M3 booked, with no polling or delay.

M3 receives `PROMOTED` carrying C1's name and time through the existing channel (P-4) … the default is in-app status only … Delivery failure of a notification does not undo a promotion, removal or expiry.
M1 and M2 cancel concurrently → promotions are M3 then M4 in either order, final booked [M3, M4], list []. … a promotion or booking never takes booked above capacity

Concurrent operations on one class behave as if they ran one at a time in some order … direct booking on a full class or with a non-empty list | none | `CLASS_FULL` (or `ON_WAITLIST_CLASS_FULL` for a listed member)
it must be decided whether a promoted booking charges at promotion … charge and penalise exactly as for a direct booking.
verdicts.missing: If a charge fails after the eligibility check passes, does the system remove or retain the entry, and does it offer the seat to the next member?

verdicts.quote: one entry per member per class; no cap on length (A-3).
When the window closes, all entries expire and no promotion occurs, even if a seat is freed afterwards. … If the app has no explicit booking cutoff, the class start time is the cutoff.

a capacity increase, and a staff removal of a booking where that action exists (P-3). Reducing capacity below the booked count removes no booking and promotes nobody until booked < capacity. … Promotions = min(free seats, eligible entries).
staff cancel the class with list [M3, M4] → both get `CLASS_CANCELLED`, the list is [], and no booking is created for M3 or M4.

verdicts.quote: new waitlist entry (class, member, join order) … member identifier and join time … *Position* = 1 + the number of entries ahead. … Waiting --> Promoted
When the window closes, all entries expire and no promotion occurs … No history is retained once an entry ends.
M4's payload contains M4's own position and the total (2 of 3) and no other member's identifier.
When the cancel request has returned, a read-back already shows M3 booked, with no polling or delay.
Classes with open seats book exactly as before. … Cancellation, the class listing and existing notifications for non-waitlist events are unchanged. … No existing data is migrated.
Existing classes start with empty waitlists. … A signed-in member viewing a full, bookable class can join its waitlist.
